newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian economy stalled, voters sceptical-Opposition.
newsitem.headline: Australian economy stalled, voters sceptical-Opposition.

text.p: The latest fall in retail trade data showed Australia's economy was stuck in the doldrums and consumers were worried about their jobs and pessimistic about the future, the Labor opposition said on Thursday.

"Today's retail figures show that the Australian economy remains in the doldrums, drifting sideways without any leadership or direction from the ... government," acting opposition leader Gareth Evans said in a statement.
Official data released on Thursday showed retail sales fell 1.8 percent in June from the previous month and dropped 0.5 percent in real terms over the June quarter.
